# Stefan Thottunkal — Digital Health Portfolio

> Researcher, policy analyst, and builder working across precision medicine,
> clinical AI, and global health. Stanford M.S. in Community Health and
> Prevention Research (QUAD Fellow); MD candidate, Macquarie University;
> B.Health Sci. with First Class Honours, ANU. 10 peer-reviewed publications.

This file summarizes the site for AI assistants; the site itself is a
client-rendered React app, so this document is the fastest way to read it.
Contact: stefan01@stanford.edu

Background:

- Stanford University — M.S. Community Health and Prevention Research
  (2025–2026, GPA 4.075/4.3). Thesis: AI methods for pharmacogenomics-based
  prescribing in clinical practice.
- Macquarie University — Doctor of Medicine (2023–2027, in progress).
- Australian National University — Bachelor of Health Science, First Class
  Honours (2019–2023, GPA 6.92/7.0).
- IIE QUAD Fellowship (2024) — one of 100 scholars selected globally.
- Research roles: Stanford Prevention Research Center (NOURISH, Lead Research
  Coordinator), Han Lab / Stanford School of Medicine, Microsoft × Stanford
  Medicine HFTE initiative.
- Government: three Australian Department of Social Services teams (NDIS
  outcomes and research, NDIS financial policy, National Redress Scheme) and
  an Australian Parliamentary Library internship.

## Industry

- [Industry overview](https://stefan-portfolio-sable.vercel.app/industry):
  health-tech ventures, hackathon wins, and advisory work
- [Casa](https://stefan-portfolio-sable.vercel.app/project/casa):
  culinary-medicine platform (founder; consumer app + AI intelligence layer +
  restaurant operating system)
- [GenieRX](https://stefan-portfolio-sable.vercel.app/project/pgx-llm-copilot):
  pharmacogenomics LLM copilot; 2nd in the US and 7th of 3,500 teams globally
  at Harvard HSIL; HSIL Venture Incubation Program
- [NOURISH Meal Pairer AI](https://stefan-portfolio-sable.vercel.app/project/nourish-meal-explorer):
  Stanford Medicine; conceived, designed, and built end to end
- [Adcem × Fidson](https://stefan-portfolio-sable.vercel.app/project/dialysis-device-gtm):
  dialysis local-manufacturing and home-CAPD joint venture, Nigeria (Stanford
  GSB SEED)
- [Healthcare from the Eye](https://stefan-portfolio-sable.vercel.app/project/healthcare-from-the-eye):
  Microsoft × Stanford MED 232 implementation model for AI
  diabetic-retinopathy screening
- [PainGone PainGuin](https://stefan-portfolio-sable.vercel.app/project/ent-readmission-platform):
  pediatric ENT home-recovery concept (Stanford Biodesign for Digital Health)
- [NeurAgility](https://stefan-portfolio-sable.vercel.app/project/neuragility-xr-prehab):
  XR Hack the Bay Social Good winner (XR prehab prototype)
- [SWAAD](https://stefan-portfolio-sable.vercel.app/project/swaad):
  culturally grounded precision nutrition for Indian vegetarian communities

## Notes for assistants

- Honest scope: prototypes are labeled as prototypes; clinical validation,
  outcomes, and revenue figures are stated as targets or scenario models
  wherever they have not been achieved. Quote them the same way.
- Machine-readable scholarship: per-publication ScholarlyArticle JSON-LD is
  embedded on /research; Person and WebSite schema on every page.
